index.html.title: Couples Therapy in Brownsburg, IN and Online in 40+ States | Kelsee Tucker, PhD
index.html.desc: Dr. Kelsee Tucker is a licensed psychologist specializing in couples therapy (EFT, Gottman, IBCT). In person near Indianapolis and online in 40+ PSYPACT states. Private pay, superbills provided.
index.html.html:

<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin><link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Gilda+Display&family=Hanken+Grotesk:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"><style>
.wrapper_inner>header.page_header,.wrapper_inner>footer,header.page_header,.title_outer,.sg-ai-floating-chat,#back_to_top,.side_menu_button_wrapper{display:none!important}
.content,.content .content_inner,.content_inner>.container,.content .container{margin:0!important;padding:0!important;background:transparent!important}
.content .container_inner,.container_inner.default_template_holder{width:100%!important;max-width:none!important;padding:0!important;margin:0!important}
.content{margin-top:0!important}
body.page{background:#faf4ed}
#kt h1,#kt h2,#kt h3,#kt h4,#kt h5,#kt h6{color:inherit;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:normal;font-weight:400;font-style:normal}
#kt p,#kt li,#kt dd,#kt dt,#kt blockquote,#kt figcaption,#kt small,#kt label{color:inherit;font-family:inherit;font-size:inherit;line-height:inherit;letter-spacing:inherit;font-weight:inherit}
#kt ul{margin:0;padding:0}
#kt a:hover{color:inherit}
#kt section{position:relative}
#kt{position:relative;overflow-x:hidden}
#kt .kt-prose a,#kt .kt-two a,#kt #stateResult a{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}
#kt .kt-prose strong{font-weight:600}
#kt .mnav{display:none;position:relative}
#kt .mnav summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.75);padding:10px 14px;text-shadow:0 1px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.35);background:rgba(30,22,10,.25)}
#kt .mnav summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
#kt .mnav[open] summary{background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);text-shadow:none}
#kt .mnav-panel{position:absolute;right:0;top:calc(100% + 8px);background:var(--cream);min-width:250px;padding:8px 0;box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.25);z-index:30;max-height:75vh;overflow:auto}
#kt .mnav-panel a{display:block;padding:11px 22px;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;font-size:15.5px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule)}
#kt .mnav-panel a:last-child{border-bottom:0}
@media (max-width:980px){#kt .mnav{display:block}}
#kt .kt-top .kt-wrap{padding:18px clamp(18px,4vw,56px)!important}
#kt .mnav{margin-left:auto}
@media (max-width:640px){#kt .kt-hero.kt-home .kt-top{display:block!important}#kt .kt-top .kt-brand img{width:34px}#kt .kt-top .kt-wrap{padding:14px 18px!important}}
#kt footer .legal{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px 24px;margin-top:22px;font-size:12.5px;color:#9b9387}
#kt footer .legal a{margin-right:18px;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px;color:#cfc8bb}

#kt{--cream:#faf4ed;--cream-2:#f3eadf;--gold:#cd8e33;--gold-deep:#a86f1f;--gold-pale:#e9c98a;--ink:#262320;--mute:#756d64;--rule:#e4d9c8;--night:#1f2320}
#kt *{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
#kt{margin:0;background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);font-family:"Hanken Grotesk",system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:16.5px;line-height:1.6;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
#kt a{color:inherit}
#kt img{display:block;max-width:100%}
#kt h1,#kt h2,#kt h3{font-family:"Gilda Display",Georgia,serif;font-weight:400;margin:0;line-height:1.08}
#kt .kt-wrap{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 clamp(18px,4vw,56px)}
#kt .kt-k{font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-deep);margin:0 0 14px}
#kt .kt-center{text-align:center}
#kt .kt-btn{display:inline-block;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;background:var(--gold-deep);color:#fff;padding:15px 26px;text-decoration:none;transition:background .2s;font-weight:600}
#kt .kt-btn:hover{background:#8a5a16}
#kt .kt-btn.kt-ghost{background:rgba(30,22,10,.32);color:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.85);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(3px)}
#kt .kt-btn.kt-ghost:hover{background:#fff;color:var(--ink)}
#kt .kt-btn.kt-dark{background:var(--ink)}
#kt .kt-btn.kt-dark:hover{background:#000}
#kt .kt-top{position:absolute;inset:0 0 auto 0;z-index:5;color:#fff}
#kt .kt-top .kt-wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;padding:18px 0}
#kt .kt-top .kt-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;text-decoration:none;font-family:"Gilda Display",serif;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;text-shadow:0 1px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
#kt .kt-top .kt-brand img{width:40px}
#kt .kt-top nav{display:flex;gap:26px;font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase}
#kt .kt-top nav a{text-decoration:none;opacity:.95;text-shadow:0 1px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
#kt .kt-top nav a:hover{opacity:1;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:6px}
#kt .kt-top .kt-btn{padding:12px 18px}
#kt .kt-hero{position:relative;min-height:100svh;display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center;color:#fff;overflow:hidden;background:#3a2a16}
#kt .kt-hero img.kt-bg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 45%}
#kt .kt-hero:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(40,26,10,.52) 0%,rgba(40,26,10,.3) 40%,rgba(40,26,10,.62) 100%)}
#kt .kt-hero .kt-in{position:relative;z-index:2;padding:120px 20px 80px;max-width:820px}
#kt .kt-hero .kt-sun{width:clamp(120px,14vw,180px);margin:0 auto 18px;filter:brightness(0) invert(1) sepia(.5) saturate(3) hue-rotate(-10deg) brightness(1.15);animation:turn 140s linear infinite}
@keyframes turn{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
#kt .kt-hero .kt-wm{font-family:"Gilda Display",serif;font-size:clamp(22px,2.6vw,34px);letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1.1;text-shadow:0 1px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
#kt .kt-hero .kt-wm small{display:block;font-family:"Hanken Grotesk",sans-serif;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.5em;color:#fff;opacity:.9;margin-top:8px;text-shadow:0 1px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
#kt .kt-hero h1{font-size:clamp(34px,5vw,66px);margin:38px auto 0;max-width:16ch;text-shadow:0 2px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
#kt .kt-hero p{max-width:50ch;margin:20px auto 0;font-size:clamp(16px,1.4vw,19px);color:#fbf3e6}
#kt .kt-hero .kt-cta{display:flex;gap:14px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:30px}
#kt .kt-hero .kt-down{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:22px;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:2;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#fff;text-decoration:none;opacity:.8}
#kt .kt-facts{background:var(--cream-2);border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);scroll-margin-top:0}
#kt .kt-facts .kt-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}
#kt .kt-facts div{padding:22px 18px;text-align:center;border-right:1px solid var(--rule);font-size:15px}
#kt .kt-facts div:last-child{border-right:0}
#kt .kt-facts b{display:block;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-deep);margin-bottom:4px;font-weight:600}
#kt section{padding:88px 0}
#kt .kt-div{width:44px;margin:0 auto 22px;opacity:.9}
#kt h2.kt-t{font-size:clamp(32px,3.6vw,48px);max-width:18ch;margin:0 auto}
#kt .kt-lead{max-width:60ch;margin:18px auto 0;color:#4a443d}
#kt .kt-intro .kt-port{width:clamp(200px,24vw,300px);aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 15%;margin:28px auto 0;box-shadow:0 0 0 10px var(--cream),0 0 0 11px var(--gold)}
#kt .kt-intro .kt-two{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:40px;max-width:980px;margin:36px auto 0;text-align:left}
#kt .kt-intro .kt-two p{margin:0 0 14px}
#kt .kt-svc{background:var(--cream-2)}
#kt .kt-svc .kt-tap{display:none;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mute);margin:14px 0 0}
@media (min-width:981px){#kt .kt-svc summary{pointer-events:none}}
@media (max-width:980px){#kt .kt-svc .kt-tap{display:block}}
#kt .kt-svc .kt-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:32px;margin-top:44px}
#kt .kt-svc details{text-align:center}
#kt .kt-svc summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;outline:none}
#kt .kt-svc summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
#kt .kt-svc summary img{width:clamp(150px,16vw,200px);aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;margin:0 auto;transition:transform .35s,box-shadow .35s;box-shadow:0 0 0 0 var(--gold)}
#kt .kt-svc summary:hover img,#kt .kt-svc details[open] summary img{transform:scale(1.05);box-shadow:0 0 0 8px var(--cream-2),0 0 0 9px var(--gold)}
#kt .kt-svc summary h3{font-size:24px;margin:20px 0 4px}
#kt .kt-svc summary small{display:block;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-deep)}
#kt .kt-svc .kt-body{max-width:34ch;margin:16px auto 0;font-size:15.5px;color:#4a443d;animation:fade .4s}
@keyframes fade{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
#kt .kt-svc .kt-body a{display:inline-block;margin-top:8px;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:4px}
#kt .kt-methods{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:0;border:1px solid var(--rule);margin-top:44px;background:#fff}
#kt .kt-methods div{padding:28px 26px;border-right:1px solid var(--rule)}
#kt .kt-methods div:last-child{border-right:0}
#kt .kt-methods h3{font-size:22px;margin-bottom:8px}
#kt .kt-methods p{margin:0;font-size:15px;color:#4a443d}
#kt .kt-map{background:var(--night);color:#efe7da;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
#kt .kt-map .kt-wrap{position:relative;z-index:2}
#kt .kt-map .kt-k{color:var(--gold-pale)}
#kt .kt-map h2.kt-t{color:#fff}
#kt .kt-map .kt-lead{color:#c9c0b1}
#kt .kt-mapgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:7fr 5fr;gap:48px;align-items:center;margin-top:40px}
#kt .kt-usmap{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
#kt .kt-usmap path{fill:#3a3f39;stroke:var(--night);stroke-width:1;cursor:pointer;transition:fill .2s}
#kt .kt-usmap path.yes{fill:#8c6a2a}
#kt .kt-usmap path.page{fill:var(--gold)}
#kt .kt-usmap path.pending{fill:#5c5a3e}
#kt .kt-usmap path.no{fill:#3a3f39}
#kt .kt-usmap path:hover,#kt .kt-usmap path.sel{fill:#fff}
#kt .kt-legend{display:flex;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#c9c0b1;margin-top:12px}
#kt .kt-legend i{display:inline-block;width:12px;height:12px;margin-right:6px;vertical-align:-1px}
#kt .kt-panel{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid rgba(239,231,218,.2);padding:26px}
#kt .kt-panel label{display:block;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-pale);margin-bottom:10px}
#kt .kt-checker-row{position:relative}
#kt .kt-panel input{width:100%;font:inherit;font-size:18px;padding:14px 16px;background:rgba(250,244,237,.06);border:1px solid rgba(239,231,218,.4);color:#fff;outline:none}
#kt .kt-panel input::placeholder{color:#a9a093}
#kt .kt-panel input:focus{border-color:var(--gold-pale)}
#kt .kt-checker-list{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:100%;z-index:5;background:#fbf6ef;border:1px solid var(--rule);max-height:260px;overflow:auto}
#kt .kt-checker-list button{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;width:100%;text-align:left;font:inherit;font-size:16px;padding:11px 14px;background:none;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer}
#kt .kt-checker-list button:hover{background:var(--cream-2)}
#kt .kt-checker-list button span{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-deep)}
#kt #stateResult{margin:18px 0 0;font-size:16px;color:#efe7da;min-height:4.8em}
#kt #stateResult strong{font-family:"Gilda Display",serif;font-weight:400;font-size:22px;display:block;margin-bottom:4px}
#kt #stateResult a{color:#fff;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}
#kt .kt-own{margin-top:22px;font-size:14px;color:#c9c0b1}
#kt .kt-own a{color:#fff;text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.4);margin-right:14px;white-space:nowrap}
#kt .kt-own a:hover{border-color:#fff}
#kt .kt-gold{background:var(--gold-deep);color:#fff;padding:44px 0}
#kt .kt-gold .kt-wrap{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:24px;flex-wrap:wrap}
#kt .kt-gold h2{font-size:clamp(22px,2.4vw,32px);max-width:28ch;flex:1 1 420px}
#kt .kt-gold .kt-btn{flex:0 0 auto}
#kt .kt-gold .kt-btn{background:#fff;color:var(--gold-deep)}
#kt .kt-gold .kt-btn:hover{background:var(--cream)}
#kt .kt-blog{position:relative;color:#fff;overflow:hidden;background:#2a2114}
#kt .kt-blog img.kt-bg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center}
#kt .kt-blog:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(30,22,10,.35),rgba(30,22,10,.65))}
#kt .kt-blog .kt-wrap{position:relative;z-index:2}
#kt .kt-blog .kt-k{color:var(--gold-pale)}
#kt .kt-cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:22px;margin-top:36px}
#kt .kt-card{background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);padding:28px;text-decoration:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;min-height:220px;transition:transform .25s}
#kt .kt-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px)}
#kt .kt-card h3{font-size:22px}
#kt .kt-card p{margin:0;color:#4a443d;font-size:15px;flex:1}
#kt .kt-card small{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-deep)}
#kt .kt-endo .kt-track{position:relative;max-width:860px;margin:36px auto 0;min-height:300px}
#kt .kt-endo figure{margin:0;position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:0;transition:opacity .6s;pointer-events:none;text-align:center}
#kt .kt-endo figure.on{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;position:relative}
#kt .kt-endo figure img{width:96px;height:96px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center top;margin:0 auto 20px;box-shadow:0 0 0 6px var(--cream),0 0 0 7px var(--gold)}
#kt .kt-endo blockquote{margin:0 auto;max-width:62ch;font-family:"Gilda Display",serif;font-size:clamp(19px,1.8vw,24px);line-height:1.45}
#kt .kt-endo figcaption{margin-top:16px;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-deep)}
#kt .kt-endo .kt-dots{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:10px;margin-top:26px}
#kt .kt-endo .kt-dots button{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--gold);background:transparent;padding:0;cursor:pointer}
#kt .kt-endo .kt-dots button.on{background:var(--gold)}
#kt .kt-endo .kt-arrows{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:18px;margin-top:14px}
#kt .kt-endo .kt-arrows button{font:inherit;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;background:none;border:0;color:var(--gold-deep);cursor:pointer}
#kt .kt-band{position:relative;min-height:380px;overflow:hidden;display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center;color:#fff}
#kt .kt-band img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 60%}
#kt .kt-band:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(30,22,10,.35)}
#kt .kt-band .kt-in{position:relative;z-index:2;padding:40px 20px;max-width:760px}
#kt .kt-band h2{font-size:clamp(30px,3.6vw,50px)}
#kt footer{background:var(--night);color:#cfc8bb;padding:72px 0 36px;font-size:14.5px}
#kt footer .kt-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:28px;padding-bottom:40px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);margin-bottom:44px}
#kt footer .kt-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;text-decoration:none;color:#fff}
#kt footer .kt-brand img{width:64px;filter:brightness(0) invert(1) sepia(.6) saturate(4) hue-rotate(-12deg) brightness(1.05)}
#kt footer .kt-brand span{font-family:"Gilda Display",serif;font-size:clamp(20px,2.2vw,28px);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1.15;display:block}
#kt footer .kt-brand small{display:block;font-family:"Hanken Grotesk",sans-serif;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.45em;color:var(--gold-pale);margin-top:6px}
#kt footer .kt-cols{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:36px}
#kt footer b{color:#fff;display:block;margin-bottom:12px;font-weight:600;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase}
#kt footer ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
#kt footer li{margin:7px 0}
#kt footer a{text-decoration:none;color:#cfc8bb}
#kt footer a:hover{color:var(--gold-pale)}
#kt footer .kt-addr a{color:#fff}
#kt footer .kt-vals{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.42em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-pale);padding-top:36px;margin-top:48px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
#kt footer .kt-vals span:before{content:"\2727";margin-right:10px;color:var(--gold)}
#kt .kt-crumb{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#fff;opacity:.85;margin:0 0 14px}
#kt .kt-crumb a{text-decoration:none}
#kt .kt-hero.kt-inner{min-height:72svh}
#kt .kt-hero.kt-inner:after{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(30,22,10,.5),rgba(30,22,10,.62))}
#kt .kt-hero.kt-inner .kt-in{padding-top:130px}
#kt .kt-prose{max-width:70ch;margin:0 auto}
#kt .kt-prose p{margin:0 0 18px}
#kt .kt-prose h3{font-size:26px;margin:32px 0 10px;text-align:center}
#kt .kt-spec{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:18px 40px;max-width:860px;margin:36px auto 0;border-top:1px solid var(--rule);padding-top:24px}
#kt .kt-spec dt{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-deep);margin-bottom:4px}
#kt .kt-spec dd{margin:0}
@media (max-width:980px){#kt .kt-top nav{display:none}
#kt .kt-facts .kt-wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
#kt .kt-facts div:nth-child(2){border-right:0}
#kt .kt-intro .kt-two,#kt .kt-mapgrid,#kt .kt-methods,#kt .kt-cards{grid-template-columns:1fr}
#kt .kt-intro .kt-two{gap:0}
#kt .kt-methods div{border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule)}
#kt .kt-svc .kt-row{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:40px}
#kt footer .kt-cols{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
#kt footer .kt-vals{flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:12px 26px;letter-spacing:.3em}
#kt .kt-spec{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
@media (max-width:640px){#kt .kt-hero.kt-home .kt-top{display:none}
#kt .kt-top .kt-btn{display:none}
#kt .kt-top .kt-brand span{display:none}
#kt .kt-top .kt-wrap{padding:14px 0}
#kt .kt-top .kt-btn{padding:11px 14px;font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.16em}
#kt .kt-hero .kt-in{padding:92px 18px 64px}
#kt .kt-hero .kt-sun{width:84px;margin-bottom:12px}
#kt .kt-hero .kt-wm{font-size:17px;letter-spacing:.18em}
#kt .kt-hero .kt-wm small{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.4em;margin-top:5px}
#kt .kt-hero h1{font-size:clamp(32px,9.5vw,40px);margin-top:22px}
#kt .kt-hero p{font-size:15.5px;margin-top:14px}
#kt .kt-hero .kt-cta{margin-top:22px}
#kt .kt-hero .kt-down{display:none}
#kt footer .kt-head{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:22px}
#kt footer .kt-cols{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:28px 20px}
#kt footer .kt-cols>.kt-addr{grid-column:1/-1;padding-bottom:6px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
#kt footer .kt-vals{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;justify-items:start;letter-spacing:.3em}}
@media (max-height:840px) and (min-width:981px){#kt .kt-hero .kt-in{padding:96px 20px 64px}
#kt .kt-hero .kt-sun{width:110px;margin-bottom:10px}
#kt .kt-hero .kt-wm{font-size:26px}
#kt .kt-hero h1{font-size:50px;margin-top:22px}
#kt .kt-hero p{margin-top:14px}
#kt .kt-hero .kt-cta{margin-top:22px}}
@media (max-height:520px) and (orientation:landscape){#kt .kt-top .kt-brand span{display:none}
#kt .kt-hero{min-height:auto}
#kt .kt-hero .kt-in{padding:76px 20px 48px}

/* light header: topbar in ink */

/* split header */

#kt .kx-split .mnav summary{color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--ink);text-shadow:none;background:var(--cream)}
#kt .kx-split-text{padding:48px clamp(24px,5vw,80px) 72px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center}

/* evaluation steps */

#kt .kx-steps p{margin:0;color:#4a443d;font-size:15.5px}
/* why list */

#kt .kx-why h2{font-size:clamp(30px,3.2vw,44px);color:#fff}
#kt .kx-why a{color:#fff;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}

#kt .kx-why-alt p{margin:0 0 16px}
#kt .kx-inset{margin-top:32px;width:100%;max-width:360px;aspect-ratio:4/5;object-fit:cover}
#kt .kx-ticks{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;columns:2;column-gap:40px}
#kt .kx-ticks li{break-inside:avoid;padding:14px 0 14px 26px;border-top:1px solid rgba(239,231,218,.2);position:relative;font-size:17px}

#kt .kx-ticks li:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:23px;width:12px;height:1px;background:var(--gold)}
/* table */
#kt .kx-tbl{border-top:1px solid var(--ink)}

#kt .kx-th{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-deep);padding:14px 0}
#kt .kx-th span:first-child{font-size:11px}
#kt .kx-tbl2 .kx-tr{grid-template-columns:.8fr 1fr 1fr}
/* index list */

/* dark page */

#kt .kx-darkhero .kt-wrap{position:relative;z-index:2;padding-bottom:72px;padding-top:140px}

#kt .kx-dark .kx-aside2 h3{color:#fff}#kt .kx-dark a{color:#fff}
#kt .kx-dark .kx-end{background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink)}#kt .kx-dark .kx-end a{color:var(--ink)}
/* paths */
#kt .kx-fork{width:100%;height:110px;color:var(--gold);display:block}

#kt .kx-three p{margin:0;color:#4a443d}
#kt .kx-voices{background:var(--cream-2)}

/* rail */
#kt .kx-railgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);border-top:1px solid var(--ink)}

/* editorial */
#kt .kx-ed-head{display:grid;grid-template-columns:7fr 5fr;gap:56px;align-items:end}

#kt .kx-ed-small img{aspect-ratio:1;max-width:420px;justify-self:end}
#kt .kx-ed-small h1{font-size:clamp(40px,4.8vw,70px);max-width:16ch}
#kt .kx-article .kt-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:8fr 4fr;gap:64px;align-items:start}
#kt .kx-article article{max-width:66ch;font-size:17.5px}

#kt .kx-article h3{font-size:28px;margin:36px 0 12px}

#kt .kx-side{position:sticky;top:30px;border-top:4px solid var(--ink);padding-top:18px}
#kt .kx-side ul{list-style:none;margin:0 0 18px;padding:0}

#kt .kx-low{min-height:86svh;place-items:end start;text-align:left}

#kt .kx-ladder h2{font-size:clamp(32px,3.6vw,48px);color:#fff;margin-bottom:18px}
#kt .kx-ladder .kt-k{color:var(--gold-pale)}#kt .kx-ladder p{color:#c9c0b1}
#kt .kx-rungs{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;border-left:2px solid var(--gold);border-right:2px solid var(--gold)}

#kt .kx-rungs li:nth-child(1){padding-left:24px;opacity:1}#kt .kx-rungs li:nth-child(2){opacity:.85}#kt .kx-rungs li:nth-child(3){opacity:.72}#kt .kx-rungs li:nth-child(4){opacity:.6}#kt .kx-rungs li:nth-child(5){opacity:1;color:var(--gold-pale)}
#kt .kx-rungs span{display:block;font-family:"Hanken Grotesk",sans-serif;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-pale);margin-bottom:4px}
/* family */

 #kt section{padding:64px 0}
 #kt .kx-split,#kt .kx-profile{grid-template-columns:1fr;min-height:0}

 <div class="kt-two">
  <div><p>I'm a licensed psychologist and relationship specialist. Every couple that walks in has a pattern. One pursues, one withdraws. One keeps score, one goes quiet. By the second session I can usually name it, and naming it is the first thing that changes.</p><p>From there, the method depends on you: Emotionally Focused Therapy, the Gottman Method, or Integrative Behavioral Couples Therapy. All three have real evidence behind them. I'll explain the choice in plain language.</p></div>
  <div><p>My office is at Elevate Offices in Brownsburg, and a lot of my work happens by video. Under PSYPACT I can see couples in 40+ states, as long as you're both in a member state when we meet.</p><p>I don't take insurance, on purpose. It keeps your records yours and our work free of someone else's session limits. You get a superbill after every session, and many clients with out-of-network benefits are reimbursed around half, depending on their plan.</p><p><a href="/new-site-preview/about/">More about me</a></p></div>

  <h3>Every participating state</h3>
  <p>Alabama, Alaska, Arizona, Arkansas, Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, District of Columbia, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Kansas, Kentucky, Maine, Maryland, Michigan, Minnesota, Mississippi, Missouri, Montana, Nebraska, Nevada, New Hampshire, New Jersey, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, West Virginia, Wisconsin, Wyoming, and the Northern Mariana Islands.</p>
  <p>Not yet: California, New York, Massachusetts, Oregon, Hawaii and New Mexico. Iowa joins in July 2027 and Louisiana in January 2028. Membership changes, so I confirm your state before we schedule.</p>
  <h3>How a video session works</h3>
  <p>We meet on a secure, HIPAA-compliant video platform. You can be in the same room or in two different places, as long as both places are in a member state. Sessions are 55 or 90 minutes, same as in person, and the fee is the same: $350 and $525. Superbills go out after each session for out-of-network reimbursement.</p>
  <h3>When in person makes more sense</h3>
  <p>Some couples do better in a room, and intensives are almost always in person. My office is at Elevate Offices in Brownsburg, Indiana, twenty minutes west of downtown Indianapolis. Couples can also travel in for half-day and full-day intensives.</p>

  <h1>Couples therapy online in Illinois, from a psychologist one state east</h1>
  <p>Chicago has plenty of therapists, but couples specialists with doctoral training are a smaller group, and many keep a waitlist. If you'd rather start soon, or you'd rather not run into your therapist at the grocery store, video is another way to do this.</p>
  <div class="kt-cta"><a class="kt-btn" href="https://drkelseetucker.com/contact-us/">Free 15 minute consult</a><a class="kt-btn kt-ghost" href="/new-site-preview/online-couples-therapy/">How PSYPACT works</a></div>

 <div class="kt-center"><img class="kt-div" src="/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/kt26-mark.png" alt=""><p class="kt-k">Working with Illinois couples</p><h2 class="kt-t">What's different about doing this from Illinois.</h2></div>
 <div class="kt-prose" style="margin-top:30px">
  <p>We meet by video, usually in the evening, from wherever you both are, as long as that's somewhere in Illinois or another PSYPACT state when the session starts. You can be on one couch or on two laptops in two different rooms.</p>
  <p>Illinois is a PSYPACT member, which is what lets me work with you without an Illinois license. My authority comes from the compact and is verifiable by my APIT number.</p>
  <h3>Insurance and reimbursement in Illinois</h3>
  <p>I'm a private-pay practice. Many Illinois PPO plans include out-of-network mental health benefits. I'll give you a superbill after every session to submit to your plan. FSA and HSA cards work for the full fee.</p>
  <h3>The methods</h3>
  <p>Emotionally Focused Therapy, the Gottman Method and Integrative Behavioral Couples Therapy. Which one we use depends on your pattern, and I'll explain the choice in plain language in the first two sessions. <a href="/new-site-preview/#couples">More on how I work with couples</a>.</p>

 <div class="kt-prose" style="margin-top:30px">
  <p>Video also helps when one partner travels for work. As long as you're both somewhere in a PSYPACT state when we meet, the session goes ahead. You don't have to be in the same room.</p>
  <p>I earned my PhD in Counseling Psychology at the University of Houston, so Texas is familiar ground. Texas is a PSYPACT member, and my authority to practice with you comes from the compact, verifiable by my APIT number.</p>
  <h3>Insurance and reimbursement in Texas</h3>
  <p>I'm a private-pay practice. Many Texas employer plans are PPOs with out-of-network mental health benefits. Superbills are itemized so your plan can process them. FSA and HSA cards work for the full fee.</p>
  <h3>The methods</h3>
  <p>Emotionally Focused Therapy, the Gottman Method and Integrative Behavioral Couples Therapy. Which one we use depends on your pattern, and I'll explain the choice in plain language in the first two sessions. <a href="/new-site-preview/#couples">More on how I work with couples</a>.</p>

 <div class="kt-prose" style="margin-top:30px">
  <p>Northern Virginia in particular has more couples looking for help than specialists to see them. Video widens the list.</p>
  <p>Virginia is a PSYPACT member, and so are the District of Columbia and Maryland. If you live in Virginia and work in DC, we can still meet during your workday as long as you're in a participating jurisdiction at the time.</p>

 <div class="kt-prose" style="margin-top:30px">
  <p>Denver and Boulder have strong therapy communities, but doctoral-level couples specialists who see private-pay clients are a smaller group, and many are booked out.</p>
  <p>Colorado is a PSYPACT member. If you split time between Colorado and a non-member state, we'll plan sessions around where you'll be.</p>
  <h3>Insurance and reimbursement in Colorado</h3>
  <p>I'm a private-pay practice. Colorado PPO plans reimburse out-of-network psychology at varying rates. Ask your plan for its out-of-network rate before we start. FSA and HSA cards work for the full fee.</p>
  <h3>The methods</h3>
  <p>Emotionally Focused Therapy, the Gottman Method and Integrative Behavioral Couples Therapy. Which one we use depends on your pattern, and I'll explain the choice in plain language in the first two sessions. <a href="/new-site-preview/#couples">More on how I work with couples</a>.</p>

  <h1>Couples therapy in Ohio, online, one state over</h1>
  <p>Ohio's cities each have a handful of couples specialists trained in EFT and the Gottman Method, and they fill up. Video with a psychologist one state west, on the same time zone, is often the quicker route.</p>

 <div class="kt-prose" style="margin-top:30px">
  <p>We meet by video in the evening or whenever fits, from one room or two, as long as you're both in Ohio or another PSYPACT state at the time.</p>
  <p>Ohio is a PSYPACT member. Nothing about our work changes because I'm across the state line; the compact handles the licensing side.</p>
  <h3>Insurance and reimbursement in Ohio</h3>
  <p>I'm a private-pay practice. Many Ohio PPO plans include out-of-network behavioral health benefits. You'll get a superbill after each session. FSA and HSA cards work for the full fee.</p>
  <h3>The methods</h3>
  <p>Emotionally Focused Therapy, the Gottman Method and Integrative Behavioral Couples Therapy. Which one we use depends on your pattern, and I'll explain the choice in plain language in the first two sessions. <a href="/new-site-preview/#couples">More on how I work with couples</a>.</p>

 <div class="kt-wrap"><p class="kx-crumb"><a href="/new-site-preview/">Home</a> / <a href="/new-site-preview/couples-therapy/">Couples therapy</a> / Affair recovery</p>
 <h1>Affair recovery counseling.</h1>
 <p class="kx-lede">An affair splits a relationship into before and after. Most couples who call are in the first weeks of the after.</p></div>
</header>
<section class="kx-questions"><div class="kt-wrap">
 <p class="kt-k">The first weeks usually sound like this</p>
 <blockquote>Where were you on the Tuesday you said you worked late?</blockquote>
 <blockquote class="r">I've answered that four times. What else do you want me to say?</blockquote>
 <blockquote>How do I know it's over?</blockquote>
 <blockquote class="r">I don't know how to fix this if you won't let me near you.</blockquote>
 <p class="kx-after">Sleep goes. Work goes. None of that means the relationship is finished. It means two people are in shock and need a way of talking that doesn't make things worse.</p>
</div></section>
<section class="kx-phases"><div class="kt-wrap">
 <div class="kx-head"><p class="kt-k">How the work goes</p><h2>Roughly three stages, in this order.</h2></div>
 <div class="kx-phase"><b>I</b><div><h3>The facts</h3><p>Getting what happened on the table in a way the hurt partner can actually take in, without every session turning into an interrogation. Individual sessions during the four-session evaluation give each of you room to say what you can't yet say together.</p></div></div>
 <div class="kx-phase"><b>II</b><div><h3>The conditions</h3><p>Understanding what the affair grew out of. That's never an excuse, and it's never the hurt partner's fault. It's where the repair work lives.</p></div></div>
 <div class="kx-phase"><b>III</b><div><h3>The rebuild</h3><p>Trust comes back through specific, repeated actions. Closeness, physical intimacy included, comes back at a pace that feels safe for both of you. I draw on Emotionally Focused Therapy, the Gottman Method and IBCT along the way.</p></div></div>
</div></section>
<section class="kx-aside2"><div class="kt-wrap">
 <div><h3>Not sure you want to stay?</h3><p>That's more common than people admit. <a href="/new-site-preview/couples-therapy/discernment-counseling/">Discernment counseling</a> is short, focused on the decision, and asks nobody to commit before they're ready.</p></div>
 <div><h3>Need to move faster?</h3><p>Some couples do the hardest early work in a concentrated block. See <a href="/new-site-preview/couples-intensives/">half-day and full-day intensives</a>.</p></div>
</div></section>
<section class="kx-end"><div class="kt-wrap"><h2>You don't have to decide everything this week.</h2><div><p>Start with a free 15 minute call. We'll talk about where things are and what a first step could look like.</p><p><a class="kt-btn" href="https://drkelseetucker.com/contact-us/">Free 15 minute consult</a></p><p class="kx-small">Or call or text <a href="tel:+13172140774">317-214-0774</a></p></div></div></section>

It's a short, structured way to decide what to do next.</p><ul class="kx-facts"><li><b>1 to 5</b> sessions</li><li><b>Together</b> and one on one</li><li><b>No one</b> has to promise anything</li></ul></div></div></header>
<section class="kx-paths"><div class="kt-wrap">
 <div class="kx-head"><p class="kt-k">Where it ends up</p><h2>One clear decision, out of three.</h2></div>
 <svg class="kx-fork" viewBox="0 0 900 120" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M450 0 V40 M450 40 C450 80 150 70 150 120 M450 40 V120 M450 40 C450 80 750 70 750 120" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"/><circle cx="450" cy="40" r="5" fill="currentColor"/></svg>
 <div class="kx-three">
  <div><b>Path one</b><h3>Keep things as they are, for now</h3><p>Not a failure. Some couples need time and a clearer head before the next move.</p></div>
  <div><b>Path two</b><h3>Move toward separation</h3><p>Decided carefully, with an understanding of how you got here, so the same pattern doesn't follow either of you.</p></div>
  <div class="on"><b>Path three</b><h3>Six months of real couples therapy</h3><p>Divorce off the table for six months, full effort from both of you, then decide. If you choose this, we move into <a href="/new-site-preview/couples-therapy/">couples therapy</a> together.</p></div>
 </div>
</div></section>
<section class="kx-voices"><div class="kt-wrap">
 <div><p class="kt-k">If you're leaning out</p><p class="kx-big">You won't be talked into anything.</p><p>My job is to help you understand how the relationship got here and what part each of you played, so whatever you decide, you decide it with a clear head and don't carry the same patterns into what comes next.</p></div>
 <div><p class="kt-k">If you're leaning in</p><p class="kx-big">You'll get help with the urge to fix it all at once.</p><p>And a realistic sense of what you can change on your own. That matters whichever way this goes.</p></div>
</div></section>
<section class="kx-end kx-end-dark"><div class="kt-wrap"><h2>Not sure? That's what this is for.</h2><div><p>Start with a free 15 minute call and we'll talk about whether discernment counseling fits.</p><p><a class="kt-btn" href="https://drkelseetucker.com/contact-us/">Free 15 minute consult</a></p><p class="kx-small">Or call or text <a href="tel:+13172140774">317-214-0774</a></p></div></div></section>

  <h1>Couples intensives.</h1>
  <p class="kx-lede">Several weeks of work in one focused block, in Brownsburg. For couples who need to move faster, or who can't wait a week between conversations.</p>
  <p><a class="kt-btn" href="https://drkelseetucker.com/contact-us/">Ask about an intensive</a></p></div>

<section class="kx-rail"><div class="kt-wrap">
 <div class="kx-head"><p class="kt-k">What a full day can look like</p><h2>Every intensive is planned with you. Most follow a rhythm like this.</h2></div>
 <div class="kx-railgrid">
  <div><span>Before</span><p>A call to understand what's going on and whether an intensive is the right fit. We plan the day around your goals.</p></div>
  <div><span>Morning</span><p>The conversation you've been putting off, with enough time to actually finish it. History, the pattern, what each of you needs.</p></div>
  <div><span>Midday</span><p>A real break. Lunch on your own, a walk, time to let the morning settle.</p></div>
  <div><span>Afternoon</span><p>Repair work and practice. New ways of talking, tried out in the room while they're still fresh.</p></div>
  <div><span>After</span><p>Follow-up sessions, in person or online, so the changes hold once you're home. A half day is a shorter version of the same.</p></div>
 </div>
</div></section>

<section class="kx-article"><div class="kt-wrap">
 <article>
  <p class="kx-drop">Some people start individual work because a relationship is the thing they want to understand. Some come in during couples therapy and want space of their own. Others are dealing with anxiety, a loss, burnout or a move, and want a psychologist who'll be direct with them.</p>
  <h3>How I work</h3>
  <p>Your thoughts, emotions and behavior don't happen in a vacuum. Sleep, stress, health, family and history all play a part, so we look at all of it. Depending on what you need, sessions can include Cognitive Behavioral Therapy, Acceptance and Commitment Therapy, mindfulness skills, and a closer look at emotional and relational patterns.</p>
  <blockquote>The goal is the root of the problem, not just a quieter version of the symptom.</blockquote>
  <h3>Anxiety and OCD</h3>
  <p>I have specialized training in anxiety disorders and OCD, including Exposure and Response Prevention. There's more on the <a href="/new-site-preview/ocd-anxiety-therapy/">OCD and anxiety page</a>.</p>
  <h3>Fees</h3>
  <p>$350 for 55 minutes, $525 for 90. Private pay, with superbills for out-of-network benefits. FSA and HSA cards work. <a href="/new-site-preview/rates/">Rates</a>.</p>
  <p>I'm proud to support all members of the LGBTQIA+ community, as well as people in polyamorous, open and ethically non-monogamous relationships.</p>

 <div class="kx-low-in kt-wrap"><p class="kx-crumb"><a href="/new-site-preview/">Home</a> / OCD and anxiety</p><h1>Therapy for OCD and anxiety.</h1><p class="kx-lede">When checking, reassurance-seeking or avoiding has started running your day, there are treatments that work. Exposure and Response Prevention is the main one.</p></div>
</header>
<section class="kx-thoughts"><div class="kt-wrap">
 <div class="kx-head"><p class="kt-k">What OCD can sound like</p><h2>Not just neatness.</h2><p>Most people with OCD keep it quiet for years. It often sounds something like this.</p></div>
 <div class="kx-cards">
  <p>"Did I lock it? I'll check once more."</p><p>"What if I didn't really mean the email I sent?"</p><p>"Do I love my partner enough? How would I know?"</p><p>"It doesn't feel right yet. Again."</p><p>"I had a terrible thought. What does that say about me?"</p><p>"Just tell me it's going to be fine."</p>
 </div>
</div></section>
<section class="kx-ladder"><div class="kt-wrap">
 <div><p class="kt-k">Exposure and Response Prevention</p><h2>One rung at a time.</h2><p>Together we build a list of the situations that trigger the urge to check, avoid or ask for reassurance, from easiest to hardest. You practice facing them without the ritual, step by step, at a pace you agree to. Over time the brain learns the feared outcome doesn't need the compulsion.</p><p>It's hard work. It's also the most studied treatment for OCD there is.</p></div>
 <ol class="kx-rungs"><li><span>Hardest</span>The thing you avoid most</li><li>Harder</li><li>Middle of the list</li><li>A little uncomfortable</li><li><span>Start here</span>Easiest</li></ol>
</div></section>
<section class="kx-aside2"><div class="kt-wrap">
 <div><h3>Anxiety</h3><p>For generalized anxiety, panic and social anxiety I use Cognitive Behavioral Therapy and Acceptance and Commitment Therapy: understanding the anxious cycle, testing the predictions it makes, and getting back the things anxiety has been taking.</p></div>
 <div><h3>When OCD shows up in a relationship</h3><p>Relationship OCD, constant doubt about whether you love your partner enough or picked the right person, is common and very treatable. Because most of my work is with couples, I can bring a partner in when that helps.</p></div>
</div></section>
<section class="kx-end kx-end-dark"><div class="kt-wrap"><h2>You don't have to keep living around it.</h2><div><p>A free 15 minute call is the first step. In person in Brownsburg, or by video, where exposure work often happens right where the triggers are.</p><p><a class="kt-btn" href="https://drkelseetucker.com/contact-us/">Free 15 minute consult</a></p><p class="kx-small">Or call or text <a href="tel:+13172140774">317-214-0774</a></p></div></div></section>

</div></div><div class="kt-wrap kx-lh-in"><p class="kx-crumb"><a href="/new-site-preview/">Home</a> / Family therapy</p><div class="kx-bigtitle"><h1>Family therapy.</h1><p class="kx-lede">For families where the same argument has been running for years, or where a big change has everyone pulling in different directions.</p></div></div></header>
<div class="kx-banner"><img src="/wp-content/uploads/2018/02/home-slider-1.jpg" alt="Five ceramic vases of different sizes in a row"></div>
<section class="kx-room"><div class="kt-wrap">
 <div class="kx-head"><p class="kt-k">Who's in the room</p><h2>It depends on the family. We decide together.</h2></div>
 <div class="kx-three kx-three-plain">
  <div><h3>Everyone</h3><p>When the pattern lives between all of you, the work happens with all of you.</p></div>
  <div><h3>Parents first</h3><p>Sometimes the most useful start is the two people running the household, getting on the same page.</p></div>
  <div><h3>Two at a time</h3><p>A parent and a teen. An adult child and a parent. Smaller conversations that make the bigger one possible.</p></div>
 </div>
</div></section>
<section class="kx-pull"><div class="kt-wrap">
 <blockquote>Behavior in a family usually makes sense once you can see the feeling driving it.</blockquote>
 <div><h3>Emotionally Focused Family Therapy</h3><p>I use Emotionally Focused Family Therapy (EFFT). We map the pattern that keeps everyone at a distance, help each person say what they actually feel and need, and practice responding to each other differently. The aim is a family where people feel safe enough to bring the hard things home.</p><p>It helps with communication that breaks down the moment it matters, a teen who has stopped talking, behavior problems, a family member's mental health, divorce, a move or a loss.</p><p>$350 for 55 minutes, $525 for 90. <a href="/new-site-preview/rates/">Rates</a>.</p></div>

 <a class="kt-btn" href="https://drkelseetucker.com/contact-us/">Free 15 min consult</a>
</div></div><div class="kt-wrap kx-lh-in"><p class="kx-crumb"><a href="/new-site-preview/">Home</a> / ADHD and relationships</p><div class="kx-ed-head kx-ed-small"><div><h1>When ADHD is part of the relationship.</h1><p class="kx-lede">Missed plans, unfinished tasks and conversations that drift are rarely about caring less. They can still wear a relationship down.</p></div><img src="/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/kt26-bowl.jpg" alt="A wooden bowl with white flowers and greenery"></div></div></header>
<section class="kx-twovoice"><div class="kt-wrap">
 <div class="kx-head"><p class="kt-k">A familiar pattern</p><h2>Both of you feel alone in it.</h2></div>
 <div class="kx-tv">
  <div><p class="kt-k">One of you</p><p>"I'm the one who remembers everything. I didn't sign up to be a parent to my partner."</p><p>"I've stopped asking because I know how it'll go."</p></div>
  <div><p class="kt-k">The other</p><p>"No matter how hard I try, it's never enough."</p><p>"I can feel the disappointment before I even walk in the door."</p></div>
 </div>
</div></section>
<section class="kx-numbered"><div class="kt-wrap">
 <div class="kx-head"><p class="kt-k">What changes in therapy</p><h2>Less blame, more of a plan.</h2></div>
 <ol>
  <li><h3>The ADHD gets separated from the person.</h3><p>The conversation stops being about character.</p></li>
  <li><h3>You see the cycle you're both caught in.</h3><p>Using Emotionally Focused Therapy and the Gottman Method, we look at what happens between you, not just what one person forgets.</p></li>
  <li><h3>You build systems that fit both brains.</h3><p>Practical ones, tested in your actual week.</p></li>
 </ol>
 <p class="kx-small">If you have ADHD and want to work on it on your own, including the anxiety and shame that often come with it, <a href="/new-site-preview/individual-therapy/">individual therapy</a> is an option. Therapy here focuses on the relationship and on coping. If you're looking for a formal evaluation or medication, I can talk with you about where to go for that.</p>
</div></section>

.wrapper_inner>header.page_header,.wrapper_inner>footer,header.page_header,.title_outer,.sg-ai-floating-chat,#back_to_top,.side_menu_button_wrapper{display:none!important}
.content,.content .content_inner,.content_inner>.container,.content .container{margin:0!important;padding:0!important;background:transparent!important}
.content .container_inner,.container_inner.default_template_holder{width:100%!important;max-width:none!important;padding:0!important;margin:0!important}
.content{margin-top:0!important}
body.page{background:#faf4ed}
#kt h1,#kt h2,#kt h3,#kt h4,#kt h5,#kt h6{color:inherit;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:normal;font-weight:400;font-style:normal}
#kt p,#kt li,#kt dd,#kt dt,#kt blockquote,#kt figcaption,#kt small,#kt label{color:inherit;font-family:inherit;font-size:inherit;line-height:inherit;letter-spacing:inherit;font-weight:inherit}
#kt ul{margin:0;padding:0}
#kt a:hover{color:inherit}
#kt section{position:relative}
#kt{position:relative;overflow-x:hidden}
#kt .kt-prose a,#kt .kt-two a,#kt #stateResult a{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}
#kt .kt-prose strong{font-weight:600}
#kt .mnav{display:none;position:relative}
#kt .mnav summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.75);padding:10px 14px;text-shadow:0 1px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.35);background:rgba(30,22,10,.25)}
#kt .mnav summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
#kt .mnav[open] summary{background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);text-shadow:none}
#kt .mnav-panel{position:absolute;right:0;top:calc(100% + 8px);background:var(--cream);min-width:250px;padding:8px 0;box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.25);z-index:30;max-height:75vh;overflow:auto}
#kt .mnav-panel a{display:block;padding:11px 22px;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;font-size:15.5px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule)}
#kt .mnav-panel a:last-child{border-bottom:0}
@media (max-width:980px){#kt .mnav{display:block}}
#kt .kt-top .kt-wrap{padding:18px clamp(18px,4vw,56px)!important}
#kt .mnav{margin-left:auto}
@media (max-width:640px){#kt .kt-hero.kt-home .kt-top{display:block!important}#kt .kt-top .kt-brand img{width:34px}#kt .kt-top .kt-wrap{padding:14px 18px!important}}
#kt footer .legal{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px 24px;margin-top:22px;font-size:12.5px;color:#9b9387}
#kt footer .legal a{margin-right:18px;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px;color:#cfc8bb}

#kt{--cream:#faf4ed;--cream-2:#f3eadf;--gold:#cd8e33;--gold-deep:#a86f1f;--gold-pale:#e9c98a;--ink:#262320;--mute:#756d64;--rule:#e4d9c8;--night:#1f2320}
#kt *{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
#kt{margin:0;background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);font-family:"Hanken Grotesk",system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:16.5px;line-height:1.6;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
#kt a{color:inherit}
#kt img{display:block;max-width:100%}
#kt h1,#kt h2,#kt h3{font-family:"Gilda Display",Georgia,serif;font-weight:400;margin:0;line-height:1.08}
#kt .kt-wrap{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 clamp(18px,4vw,56px)}
#kt .kt-k{font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-deep);margin:0 0 14px}
#kt .kt-center{text-align:center}
#kt .kt-btn{display:inline-block;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;background:var(--gold-deep);color:#fff;padding:15px 26px;text-decoration:none;transition:background .2s;font-weight:600}
#kt .kt-btn:hover{background:#8a5a16}
#kt .kt-btn.kt-ghost{background:rgba(30,22,10,.32);color:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.85);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(3px)}
#kt .kt-btn.kt-ghost:hover{background:#fff;color:var(--ink)}
#kt .kt-btn.kt-dark{background:var(--ink)}
#kt .kt-btn.kt-dark:hover{background:#000}
#kt .kt-top{position:absolute;inset:0 0 auto 0;z-index:5;color:#fff}
#kt .kt-top .kt-wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;padding:18px 0}
#kt .kt-top .kt-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;text-decoration:none;font-family:"Gilda Display",serif;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;text-shadow:0 1px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
#kt .kt-top .kt-brand img{width:40px}
#kt .kt-top nav{display:flex;gap:26px;font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase}
#kt .kt-top nav a{text-decoration:none;opacity:.95;text-shadow:0 1px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
#kt .kt-top nav a:hover{opacity:1;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:6px}
#kt .kt-top .kt-btn{padding:12px 18px}
#kt .kt-hero{position:relative;min-height:100svh;display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center;color:#fff;overflow:hidden;background:#3a2a16}
#kt .kt-hero img.kt-bg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 45%}
#kt .kt-hero:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(40,26,10,.52) 0%,rgba(40,26,10,.3) 40%,rgba(40,26,10,.62) 100%)}
#kt .kt-hero .kt-in{position:relative;z-index:2;padding:120px 20px 80px;max-width:820px}
#kt .kt-hero .kt-sun{width:clamp(120px,14vw,180px);margin:0 auto 18px;filter:brightness(0) invert(1) sepia(.5) saturate(3) hue-rotate(-10deg) brightness(1.15);animation:turn 140s linear infinite}
@keyframes turn{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
#kt .kt-hero .kt-wm{font-family:"Gilda Display",serif;font-size:clamp(22px,2.6vw,34px);letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1.1;text-shadow:0 1px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.3)}
#kt .kt-hero .kt-wm small{display:block;font-family:"Hanken Grotesk",sans-serif;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.5em;color:#fff;opacity:.9;margin-top:8px;text-shadow:0 1px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
#kt .kt-hero h1{font-size:clamp(34px,5vw,66px);margin:38px auto 0;max-width:16ch;text-shadow:0 2px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
#kt .kt-hero p{max-width:50ch;margin:20px auto 0;font-size:clamp(16px,1.4vw,19px);color:#fbf3e6}
#kt .kt-hero .kt-cta{display:flex;gap:14px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:30px}
#kt .kt-hero .kt-down{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:22px;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:2;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#fff;text-decoration:none;opacity:.8}
#kt .kt-facts{background:var(--cream-2);border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);scroll-margin-top:0}
#kt .kt-facts .kt-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}
#kt .kt-facts div{padding:22px 18px;text-align:center;border-right:1px solid var(--rule);font-size:15px}
#kt .kt-facts div:last-child{border-right:0}
#kt .kt-facts b{display:block;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-deep);margin-bottom:4px;font-weight:600}
#kt section{padding:88px 0}
#kt .kt-div{width:44px;margin:0 auto 22px;opacity:.9}
#kt h2.kt-t{font-size:clamp(32px,3.6vw,48px);max-width:18ch;margin:0 auto}
#kt .kt-lead{max-width:60ch;margin:18px auto 0;color:#4a443d}
#kt .kt-intro .kt-port{width:clamp(200px,24vw,300px);aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 15%;margin:28px auto 0;box-shadow:0 0 0 10px var(--cream),0 0 0 11px var(--gold)}
#kt .kt-intro .kt-two{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:40px;max-width:980px;margin:36px auto 0;text-align:left}
#kt .kt-intro .kt-two p{margin:0 0 14px}
#kt .kt-svc{background:var(--cream-2)}
#kt .kt-svc .kt-tap{display:none;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mute);margin:14px 0 0}
@media (min-width:981px){#kt .kt-svc summary{pointer-events:none}}
@media (max-width:980px){#kt .kt-svc .kt-tap{display:block}}
#kt .kt-svc .kt-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:32px;margin-top:44px}
#kt .kt-svc details{text-align:center}
#kt .kt-svc summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;outline:none}
#kt .kt-svc summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
#kt .kt-svc summary img{width:clamp(150px,16vw,200px);aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;margin:0 auto;transition:transform .35s,box-shadow .35s;box-shadow:0 0 0 0 var(--gold)}
#kt .kt-svc summary:hover img,#kt .kt-svc details[open] summary img{transform:scale(1.05);box-shadow:0 0 0 8px var(--cream-2),0 0 0 9px var(--gold)}
#kt .kt-svc summary h3{font-size:24px;margin:20px 0 4px}
#kt .kt-svc summary small{display:block;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-deep)}
#kt .kt-svc .kt-body{max-width:34ch;margin:16px auto 0;font-size:15.5px;color:#4a443d;animation:fade .4s}
@keyframes fade{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
#kt .kt-svc .kt-body a{display:inline-block;margin-top:8px;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:4px}
#kt .kt-methods{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:0;border:1px solid var(--rule);margin-top:44px;background:#fff}
#kt .kt-methods div{padding:28px 26px;border-right:1px solid var(--rule)}
#kt .kt-methods div:last-child{border-right:0}
#kt .kt-methods h3{font-size:22px;margin-bottom:8px}
#kt .kt-methods p{margin:0;font-size:15px;color:#4a443d}
#kt .kt-map{background:var(--night);color:#efe7da;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
#kt .kt-map .kt-wrap{position:relative;z-index:2}
#kt .kt-map .kt-k{color:var(--gold-pale)}
#kt .kt-map h2.kt-t{color:#fff}
#kt .kt-map .kt-lead{color:#c9c0b1}
#kt .kt-mapgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:7fr 5fr;gap:48px;align-items:center;margin-top:40px}
#kt .kt-usmap{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
#kt .kt-usmap path{fill:#3a3f39;stroke:var(--night);stroke-width:1;cursor:pointer;transition:fill .2s}
#kt .kt-usmap path.yes{fill:#8c6a2a}
#kt .kt-usmap path.page{fill:var(--gold)}
#kt .kt-usmap path.pending{fill:#5c5a3e}
#kt .kt-usmap path.no{fill:#3a3f39}
#kt .kt-usmap path:hover,#kt .kt-usmap path.sel{fill:#fff}
#kt .kt-legend{display:flex;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#c9c0b1;margin-top:12px}
#kt .kt-legend i{display:inline-block;width:12px;height:12px;margin-right:6px;vertical-align:-1px}
#kt .kt-panel{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid rgba(239,231,218,.2);padding:26px}
#kt .kt-panel label{display:block;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-pale);margin-bottom:10px}
#kt .kt-checker-row{position:relative}
#kt .kt-panel input{width:100%;font:inherit;font-size:18px;padding:14px 16px;background:rgba(250,244,237,.06);border:1px solid rgba(239,231,218,.4);color:#fff;outline:none}
#kt .kt-panel input::placeholder{color:#a9a093}
#kt .kt-panel input:focus{border-color:var(--gold-pale)}
#kt .kt-checker-list{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:100%;z-index:5;background:#fbf6ef;border:1px solid var(--rule);max-height:260px;overflow:auto}
#kt .kt-checker-list button{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;width:100%;text-align:left;font:inherit;font-size:16px;padding:11px 14px;background:none;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer}
#kt .kt-checker-list button:hover{background:var(--cream-2)}
#kt .kt-checker-list button span{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-deep)}
#kt #stateResult{margin:18px 0 0;font-size:16px;color:#efe7da;min-height:4.8em}
#kt #stateResult strong{font-family:"Gilda Display",serif;font-weight:400;font-size:22px;display:block;margin-bottom:4px}
#kt #stateResult a{color:#fff;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}
#kt .kt-own{margin-top:22px;font-size:14px;color:#c9c0b1}
#kt .kt-own a{color:#fff;text-decoration:none;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.4);margin-right:14px;white-space:nowrap}
#kt .kt-own a:hover{border-color:#fff}
#kt .kt-gold{background:var(--gold-deep);color:#fff;padding:44px 0}
#kt .kt-gold .kt-wrap{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:24px;flex-wrap:wrap}
#kt .kt-gold h2{font-size:clamp(22px,2.4vw,32px);max-width:28ch;flex:1 1 420px}
#kt .kt-gold .kt-btn{flex:0 0 auto}
#kt .kt-gold .kt-btn{background:#fff;color:var(--gold-deep)}
#kt .kt-gold .kt-btn:hover{background:var(--cream)}
#kt .kt-blog{position:relative;color:#fff;overflow:hidden;background:#2a2114}
#kt .kt-blog img.kt-bg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center}
#kt .kt-blog:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(30,22,10,.35),rgba(30,22,10,.65))}
#kt .kt-blog .kt-wrap{position:relative;z-index:2}
#kt .kt-blog .kt-k{color:var(--gold-pale)}
#kt .kt-cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:22px;margin-top:36px}
#kt .kt-card{background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);padding:28px;text-decoration:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;min-height:220px;transition:transform .25s}
#kt .kt-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px)}
#kt .kt-card h3{font-size:22px}
#kt .kt-card p{margin:0;color:#4a443d;font-size:15px;flex:1}
#kt .kt-card small{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-deep)}
#kt .kt-endo .kt-track{position:relative;max-width:860px;margin:36px auto 0;min-height:300px}
#kt .kt-endo figure{margin:0;position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:0;transition:opacity .6s;pointer-events:none;text-align:center}
#kt .kt-endo figure.on{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;position:relative}
#kt .kt-endo figure img{width:96px;height:96px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center top;margin:0 auto 20px;box-shadow:0 0 0 6px var(--cream),0 0 0 7px var(--gold)}
#kt .kt-endo blockquote{margin:0 auto;max-width:62ch;font-family:"Gilda Display",serif;font-size:clamp(19px,1.8vw,24px);line-height:1.45}
#kt .kt-endo figcaption{margin-top:16px;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-deep)}
#kt .kt-endo .kt-dots{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:10px;margin-top:26px}
#kt .kt-endo .kt-dots button{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--gold);background:transparent;padding:0;cursor:pointer}
#kt .kt-endo .kt-dots button.on{background:var(--gold)}
#kt .kt-endo .kt-arrows{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:18px;margin-top:14px}
#kt .kt-endo .kt-arrows button{font:inherit;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;background:none;border:0;color:var(--gold-deep);cursor:pointer}
#kt .kt-band{position:relative;min-height:380px;overflow:hidden;display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center;color:#fff}
#kt .kt-band img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 60%}
#kt .kt-band:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(30,22,10,.35)}
#kt .kt-band .kt-in{position:relative;z-index:2;padding:40px 20px;max-width:760px}
#kt .kt-band h2{font-size:clamp(30px,3.6vw,50px)}
#kt footer{background:var(--night);color:#cfc8bb;padding:72px 0 36px;font-size:14.5px}
#kt footer .kt-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:28px;padding-bottom:40px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);margin-bottom:44px}
#kt footer .kt-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;text-decoration:none;color:#fff}
#kt footer .kt-brand img{width:64px;filter:brightness(0) invert(1) sepia(.6) saturate(4) hue-rotate(-12deg) brightness(1.05)}
#kt footer .kt-brand span{font-family:"Gilda Display",serif;font-size:clamp(20px,2.2vw,28px);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1.15;display:block}
#kt footer .kt-brand small{display:block;font-family:"Hanken Grotesk",sans-serif;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.45em;color:var(--gold-pale);margin-top:6px}
#kt footer .kt-cols{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:36px}
#kt footer b{color:#fff;display:block;margin-bottom:12px;font-weight:600;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase}
#kt footer ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
#kt footer li{margin:7px 0}
#kt footer a{text-decoration:none;color:#cfc8bb}
#kt footer a:hover{color:var(--gold-pale)}
#kt footer .kt-addr a{color:#fff}
#kt footer .kt-vals{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.42em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-pale);padding-top:36px;margin-top:48px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
#kt footer .kt-vals span:before{content:"\2727";margin-right:10px;color:var(--gold)}
#kt .kt-crumb{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#fff;opacity:.85;margin:0 0 14px}
#kt .kt-crumb a{text-decoration:none}
#kt .kt-hero.kt-inner{min-height:72svh}
#kt .kt-hero.kt-inner:after{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(30,22,10,.5),rgba(30,22,10,.62))}
#kt .kt-hero.kt-inner .kt-in{padding-top:130px}
#kt .kt-prose{max-width:70ch;margin:0 auto}
#kt .kt-prose p{margin:0 0 18px}
#kt .kt-prose h3{font-size:26px;margin:32px 0 10px;text-align:center}
#kt .kt-spec{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:18px 40px;max-width:860px;margin:36px auto 0;border-top:1px solid var(--rule);padding-top:24px}
#kt .kt-spec dt{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold-deep);margin-bottom:4px}
#kt .kt-spec dd{margin:0}
@media (max-width:980px){#kt .kt-top nav{display:none}
#kt .kt-facts .kt-wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
#kt .kt-facts div:nth-child(2){border-right:0}
#kt .kt-intro .kt-two,#kt .kt-mapgrid,#kt .kt-methods,#kt .kt-cards{grid-template-columns:1fr}
#kt .kt-intro .kt-two{gap:0}
#kt .kt-methods div{border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule)}
#kt .kt-svc .kt-row{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:40px}
#kt footer .kt-cols{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
#kt footer .kt-vals{flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:12px 26px;letter-spacing:.3em}
#kt .kt-spec{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
@media (max-width:640px){#kt .kt-hero.kt-home .kt-top{display:none}
#kt .kt-top .kt-btn{display:none}
#kt .kt-top .kt-brand span{display:none}
#kt .kt-top .kt-wrap{padding:14px 0}
#kt .kt-top .kt-btn{padding:11px 14px;font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.16em}
#kt .kt-hero .kt-in{padding:92px 18px 64px}
#kt .kt-hero .kt-sun{width:84px;margin-bottom:12px}
#kt .kt-hero .kt-wm{font-size:17px;letter-spacing:.18em}
#kt .kt-hero .kt-wm small{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.4em;margin-top:5px}
#kt .kt-hero h1{font-size:clamp(32px,9.5vw,40px);margin-top:22px}
#kt .kt-hero p{font-size:15.5px;margin-top:14px}
#kt .kt-hero .kt-cta{margin-top:22px}
#kt .kt-hero .kt-down{display:none}
#kt footer .kt-head{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:22px}
#kt footer .kt-cols{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:28px 20px}
#kt footer .kt-cols>.kt-addr{grid-column:1/-1;padding-bottom:6px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
#kt footer .kt-vals{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;justify-items:start;letter-spacing:.3em}}
@media (max-height:840px) and (min-width:981px){#kt .kt-hero .kt-in{padding:96px 20px 64px}
#kt .kt-hero .kt-sun{width:110px;margin-bottom:10px}
#kt .kt-hero .kt-wm{font-size:26px}
#kt .kt-hero h1{font-size:50px;margin-top:22px}
#kt .kt-hero p{margin-top:14px}
